title: The Knights' Tomb
journal: Nesh-Deeka sent me to Eurydike, the roofless hall of the Kothringi knights north of Gideon, to open the knight-captain's tomb with the keystone. The knights' dead walk the barracks wing, and the Unbound got there before me. I should search the Unbound's packs by their fire on the way to the tomb. I may fight, slip past or turn the dead with Restoration; the dead and the Unbound both attack whoever they see.
objectives: Search the Unbound's packs in Eurydike's barracks wing. (marker: Unbound Pack)

plan.going: The keystone opens the knight-captain's tomb at Eurydike; the Unbound are there ahead of me. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
plan.next: Go to Eurydike and search the Unbound's packs on the way to the tomb.
plan.ways: Fight the dead and the Unbound, slip past them, or turn the dead with Restoration.

answers: I am Tarin, a thief working for Nesh-Deeka. I hold the Kothringi Keystone, which opens the knight-captain tomb at Eurydike. The Kothringi knights guarded the road to the Root, where the Eye of Argonia lies. The Unbound have got here first and are asking about this place.
Go through Eurydike barracks wing and search the Unbound packs by their fire, then reach the locked tomb door.
Fight the restless knights or the Unbound, slip past quietly (my preference as a thief), or turn the dead with Restoration.
I do not understand seal paste, Cuts-the-Old-Knot, Xeech-Leel, Umbriel, or Collector Ennodius Vanin. I might learn from the packs, from people, or from the journal.

title: The Knights' Tomb
journal: In the Unbound's packs were bottles of the grey paste they call "the seal". It is a paralysis poison: it numbs a tree's scar shut. The Unbound drain a tree and then poison it. If they wanted the trees dead they could kill them, so why seal a tree they drain? Now the tomb: the keystone should open its door.
objectives: Open the knight-captain's tomb with the keystone and search it. (marker: Door to Knight-Captain's Tomb, Knight-Captain's Tomb Chest)

plan.going: The seal is a paralysis poison. I do not know why the Unbound seal trees they drain: that question is open. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
plan.next: Open the tomb with the keystone and search the knight-captain's chest.
plan.ways: The keystone is the door's key; the dead and the Unbound may still be about.
terms: paralysis poison (the seal): the item's name and journal 20

answers: I work for Nesh-Deeka. The Unbound left bottles of grey paste, called the seal, a paralysis poison that numbs a tree scar shut. They drain a tree then poison it, and I do not know why.
Use the keystone on the knight-captain tomb door here at Eurydike, then search the tomb chest.
Open the door with the keystone, or pick the lock; the knight and digger nearby attack if they see me, so I can sneak, fight or turn the dead.
I still do not understand Cuts-the-Old-Knot, Xeech-Leel, Umbriel, or Collector Ennodius Vanin, nor why the Unbound seal trees. I might learn from the tomb or from people.

title: The Knights' Tomb
journal: In the knight-captain's tomb lay a bronze disc stamped with a mine's mark, a pick crossed with a tower. Nesh-Deeka will know the mark.
objectives: Bring the bronze disc to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: The disc bears a mine's mark; I do not know which mine. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.

answers: I work for Nesh-Deeka. The keystone opened the tomb at Eurydike and I took a bronze disc stamped with a mine mark, a pick crossed with a tower. The Unbound seal trees they drain with paralysis poison, and I do not know why.
Bring the disc to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom, who should know the mark.
Go straight to Helstrom, or look around more first; the Unbound are nearby and asking about this place, so I should leave quietly.
I do not know what the mine mark means, or who Cuts-the-Old-Knot, Xeech-Leel, Umbriel or Collector Ennodius Vanin are. Nesh-Deeka may explain the mark.

title: The Knights' Tomb
journal: Nesh-Deeka knew the mark: Vicrium, an old mine in the clay country behind Seafalls, in the east. She already knew the Unbound had been at Eurydike, and did not say how. She does not know why the Unbound seal the trees they drain, and says it does not matter. She paid me 100 gold. The question stays with me.

plan.going: The disc points to Vicrium. Why the Unbound seal the trees is still open: Nesh-Deeka does not know. She knows where they go and will not say how. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
plan.next: MN10 starts; its first entry marks Vicrium.
terms: Vicrium: Nesh-Deeka: an old mine behind Seafalls in Okuwun Rahei

answers: The quest is done. The disc marks Vicrium, an old ochre and alum mine in the clay country behind Seafalls in Okuwun Rahei, where the knights kept a strongbox. Nesh-Deeka paid me 100 gold. She knew the Unbound were at Eurydike and would not say how, only that they listen. She does not know why the Unbound poison the trees they drain.
No new objective is shown; the next lead is Vicrium, east near Seafalls.
Go to Vicrium, ask Nesh-Deeka more, or look into the tree-sealing question.
I still do not know why the Unbound seal the trees, how Nesh-Deeka knows what she knows, or who Cuts-the-Old-Knot, Xeech-Leel, Umbriel and Collector Ennodius Vanin are.
